City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
MAY 19, 2022 -
6:00
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Item 8B is located in the Coastal Zone and requires the issuance of a Coastal Development Permit (CDP). The action of the Planning Commission relative to Item 8B may not be appealed to the California Coastal Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner, or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the Special Planning Commission meeting of March 30, 2022.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Special Meeting Minutes of March 30, 2022
6B.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the Joint Special Meeting of the Planning Commission, Environmental Commission and Urban Forest Advisory Committee – Native Plant Policy.
Meeting Minutes Workshop No. 1 - Native Plant Policy
NOTE: Commissioner Ryan was absent and will recuse herself for the vote.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Recommended Action: Staff recommends approval.
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROJECT NAME: Fox Point Farms; CASE NUMBERS: RESO-005305-2022; FILING DATE: April 6, 2022; APPLICANT: Nolen Communities, Brian Grover; LOCATION: 1150 Quail Gardens Drive (APN: 254-612-12); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a Resolution Amendment to modify a condition of approval to reflect updated maintenance responsibility from a “Master Homeowners Association” to “Property Owner”. ZONING/ OVERLAY: A portion of the project site is located within the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan (ERSP) R30 Overlay Zone and the remaining portion
within the ERSP Agricultural zone and within the Coastal Zone and Cultural Overlay Zone.; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The request has been found to be in substantial conformance with the previously certified Environmental Impact Report approved.
STAFF CONTACT: Anna Colamussi, Planning Manager: (760) 633-2724 or acolamussi@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
Fox Point Farms Revised Resolution No. PC 2020-27
8B.
PROJECT NAME: Valentina Minor Use Permit; CASE NUMBER: MULTI-004797-2021, USE-004798-2021 and CDPNF-004799-2021; ZONING/OVERLAY: The subject property is located in the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan- Commercial Mixed-1 (N-CM-1) Zone and the Coastal Zone and Special Study overlays; APPLICANT: Marco Gonzalez; LOCATION: 810 North Coast Highway 101 (APN 256-014-10); DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a Minor Use Permit and Coastal Development Permit to establish an ABC Type 47 (On-Sale General) for an existing restaurant (Valentina) operation; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is categorically exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15301, which exempts the operation, repair, maintenance, permitting, licensing of private structures, and mechanical equipment, involving negligible or no expansion of use beyond that existing at the time of the lead agency’s determination; and Section 15061(b)(3), which exempts projects where it can be seen with certainty that there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment.
STAFF CONTACT: Chris Stanley, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2785 or cstanley@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
Valentina Minor Use Permit Case #MULTI-004797-2021 810 N. Coast Highway 101
8C.
APPOINT one Planning Commissioner to the El Camino Real Specific Plan Task Force. On May 11, 2022, the City Council directed staff to create a nine-member task force with one of the members being from the Planning Commission. Specific direction included that the member be the New Encinitas Representative. If they are unavailable, then a member be appointed by the Commission.”
STAFF CONTACT: Melinda Dacey, Planner IV: (760) 633-2711 or mdacey@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends a member be appointed.
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
10.
PLANNING COMMISSION REPORTS
11.
SECRETARY REPORTS
12.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn to the regular Planning Commission meeting of June 2, 2022.
